purpose: Re-audit the three-session research frontier after the terminal Eastmoney balance-sheet-resilience return and execution result, and select at most one economically independent, reproducible public-data mechanism before observing a new provider row or factor value.

candidate_review.reason: The standard per-stock fina_indicator route already failed its one full-source attempt on an incomplete required identity, announcement-date, report-period, or version field. Selecting inv_turn, ar_turn, or assets_turn after that failure would replay the same source path and create a financial-field sweep.

Operating cash generation relative to investing or financing cash flow is too close to the terminal operating-cash-conversion mechanism. A public-provider substitute does not create an independent earnings-cash-quality hypothesis.

Operating-cost, selling-expense, management-expense, and finance-expense ratios are direct margin decompositions near the terminal gross-margin route and the existing ROE/profitability quality fields. Testing them after seeing the documented source catalog would be a same-report field sweep.

The difference between operating profit and total profit isolates the materiality of non-operating gains or losses. It is an earnings-composition mechanism, not leverage, valuation, cash conversion, gross margin, growth, price path, trading flow, ownership, or an announcement-event count.

selected_candidate.economic_mechanism: Among already profitable and growing issuers, closer agreement between positive operating profit and positive total profit indicates that disclosed earnings are less dominated by non-operating gains or losses and may be incorporated more consistently over the next three sessions.
selected_candidate.valid_row: stock code and announcement date are complete; operating profit and total profit are finite and strictly positive; the denominator is finite and strictly positive
selected_candidate.invalid_row_policy: exclude and count without clipping, filling, sign changes, field substitution, absolute-profit rescue, or inference
selected_candidate.availability: first local trading session strictly after the source announcement date
selected_candidate.quality_gate: ROE at least 5 percent, positive net profit, positive revenue YoY, and positive profit YoY under the existing next-session point-in-time policy

economic_independence.versus_existing_quarterly_quality: ROE, net-profit sign, revenue growth, profit growth, and their accelerations remain eligibility or comparison fields. The candidate uses neither their values nor weights and must pass a no-return correlation gate against them.
economic_independence.versus_balance_sheet_resilience: The terminal balance-sheet factor used total assets and total liabilities. The selected factor requests neither asset nor liability values and measures earnings composition from a different statement report.
economic_independence.versus_cash_conversion: The candidate requests no operating cash flow, financing cash flow, investment cash flow, attributable net income, or cash-conversion ratio.
economic_independence.versus_gross_margin: Gross margin measures revenue less direct operating cost. Core-profit consistency instead compares operating profit after operating expenses with pre-tax total profit to isolate non-operating materiality.
economic_independence.versus_price_volume_and_event_factors: No OHLCV, turnover, order flow, valuation, market capitalization, ownership, analyst, billboard, block-trade, pledge, repurchase, unlock, holder, or management field enters the formula.

required_gate_order: freeze the exact provider report, pinned adapter, source positions, factor formula, direction, timing, invalid-row, completeness, atomicity, capacity, and uniqueness rules before any income-statement provider row
implement and locally test count-complete pagination, positional schema rejection, formula derivation, atomic publication, and one-shot cross-clone guards
run one fixed 2025-12-31 no-price source acceptance and permanently consume it
only after acceptance, freeze a separate full-source and no-return protocol before another historical partition
run capacity before comparison fields or prices, and uniqueness before any factor return
freeze a separate one-time return and execution diagnostic only if every no-return gate passes
prohibited_actions: request or persist security name, net profit, revenue, revenue growth, operating costs, selling expense, management expense, finance expense, price, market capitalization, valuation, precomputed return, or forward return as factor inputs
replace the formula with a margin, expense ratio, operating-profit growth, non-operating direction, cash-flow field, leverage field, industry residual, or financial-sector exception after seeing rows
accept a zero or negative operating profit or total profit, or treat a missing row as perfect consistency
use same-day announcement trading, a different carry age, reversed direction, different report range, clipping, winsorization, or a lower gate
read returns, aggregate, score, select, size, order, or justify Level-2 before all no-return gates pass
